fullPassage: The ingenuity of the food industry is demonstrated by its ability to simultaneously design and market new products that appeal to consumers who want both "good-for-you" and diet foods. By offering one product line that profits by producing obesity and another that generates revenues by claiming to reduce weight, food companies have found a way to have their cake and eat it, too. In these "healthier" products, food companies remove some of the calories, sugars, fats, and salt added to "fun-to-eat foods" in order to address consumers' concerns about health. Others simply add nutrients to the same unhealthy product. For example, cereal companies simply add vitamins A, C, or iron to sweetened refined-grain products, then label them as "healthy," rather than using the whole grains recommended for healthier diets. In 2009, 86 percent of cereal marketed to children contained mostly refined grain.

det.korean: line: (A) 선/줄 (B) 제품군/계열
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 선/줄 - (B) 선/줄: (B) product line은 '제품군'
✅ ② (A) 선/줄 - (B) 제품군/계열: (A) draw a line=선을 긋다, (B) product line=제품군/제품 계열 ← 정답
❌ ③ (A) 제품군/계열 - (B) 선/줄: (A)는 '선'
❌ ④ (A) 제품군/계열 - (B) 제품군/계열: (A)는 '선'
det.tip: line: draw a line(선을 긋다) vs product line(제품군). 함께 쓰인 명사로 의미 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the condition of being extremely overweight in a way that is harmful to a person's health"

det.korean: 건강에 해로울 정도로 매우 과체중인 상태
det.analysis:
✅ ① obesity(비만): 건강에 해로울 만큼 과도하게 살이 찐 상태 ← 정답
❌ ② allergy(알레르기): 특정 물질에 대한 과민 반응
❌ ③ diet(식단/다이어트): 먹는 음식 또는 체중 조절
❌ ④ recipe(조리법): 음식 만드는 방법
det.tip: obesity=비만. producing obesity=비만을 유발하다.

questions.passage: For example, cereal companies simply add vitamins A, C, or iron to sweetened refined-grain products, then label them as "healthy," rather than using the whole grains __________ (recommend) for healthier diets. In 2009, 86 percent of cereal marketed to children contained mostly refined grain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: recommend → recommended: 명사 the whole grains를 수동의 의미로 뒤에서 수식하는 과거분사.
det.analysis:
recommend(동사, 추천하다) → recommended(과거분사). 'the whole grains ___ for healthier diets'에서 통곡물이 '추천되는' 수동의 의미로 앞의 명사를 후치 수식한다. 원래 which are recommended에서 which are가 생략된 형태.
the whole grains recommended for ~=~에 추천되는 통곡물
det.tip: 명사 뒤에서 수동으로 수식 = 과거분사(p.p.). recommend → recommended.

questions.passage: In these "healthier" products, food companies remove some of the calories, sugars, fats, and salt __________ (add) to "fun-to-eat foods" in order to address consumers' concerns about health. Others simply add nutrients to the same unhealthy product.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: add → added: 앞의 명사들(calories, sugars, fats, and salt)을 수동으로 수식하는 과거분사.
det.analysis:
add(동사, 더하다) → added(과거분사). 'the calories, sugars, fats, and salt ___ to "fun-to-eat foods"'에서 성분들이 '첨가된' 수동의 의미로 앞 명사들을 후치 수식한다. which are added에서 which are가 생략된 형태.
salt added to ~=~에 첨가된 소금
det.tip: 명사 뒤 수동 수식 = 과거분사(added). 능동 adding과 혼동 주의.

questions.passage: The ingenuity of the food industry is demonstrated by its ability to simultaneously design and market new products that appeal to consumers who want both "good-for-you" and diet foods. By offering one product line that profits by producing obesity and another that generates revenues by claiming to __________, food companies have found a way to have their cake and eat it, too. In these "healthier" products, food companies remove some of the calories, sugars, fats, and salt added to "fun-to-eat foods" in order to address consumers' concerns about health. Others simply add nutrients to the same unhealthy product. For example, cereal companies simply add vitamins A, C, or iron to sweetened refined-grain products, then label them as "healthy," rather than using the whole grains recommended for healthier diets. In 2009, 86 percent of cereal marketed to children contained mostly refined grain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 또 다른 제품군은 ______을 주장하여 수익을 창출한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① build more muscle(근육을 더 키우다): 본문은 '체중 감량' 주장을 다룸
❌ ② save their money(돈을 아끼다): 문맥과 무관
❌ ③ waste their time(시간을 낭비하다): 문맥과 무관
✅ ④ reduce weight(체중을 줄이다): 'another that generates revenues by claiming to ______' 체중 감량을 주장하는 제품군 ← 정답
det.tip: claiming to reduce weight=체중 감량을 주장하다. 비만 유발 제품(obesity)과 '양쪽 이득' 구조의 반대 축.

questions.passage: The ingenuity of the food industry is demonstrated by its ability to simultaneously design and market new products that appeal to consumers who want both "good-for-you" and diet foods. By offering one product line that profits by producing obesity and another that generates revenues by claiming to reduce weight, food companies have found a way to have their cake and eat it, too. In these "healthier" products, food companies remove some of the calories, sugars, fats, and salt added to "fun-to-eat foods" in order to address consumers' concerns about health. Others simply add nutrients to the same unhealthy product. For example, cereal companies simply add vitamins A, C, or iron to sweetened refined-grain products, then label them as "healthy," rather than using the whole grains recommended for healthier diets. In 2009, 86 percent of cereal marketed to children contained mostly __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 2009년에 어린이에게 판매된 시리얼의 86퍼센트에는 대부분 ______이 들어 있었다
det.analysis:
❌ ① fresh green vegetables(신선한 녹색 채소): 시리얼 성분으로 부적절하고 기만 논지와 상충
❌ ② pure spring water(깨끗한 샘물): 문맥과 무관
✅ ③ refined grain(정제 곡물): 통곡물 대신 '정제 곡물'을 쓰고도 '건강한'이라 표시한다는 앞 문장과 연결 ← 정답
❌ ④ organic brown rice(유기농 현미): 통곡물에 가까워 '건강한 척' 비판 논지와 모순
det.tip: 앞 문장: 통곡물(whole grains) 대신 가당 정제 곡물 사용. 그래서 86%가 mostly refined grain(정제 곡물).
